senses.gloss:
n. (-क्ष्यं)
1 Contrariety, reverse, inversion.
2 Contrary course or conduct to that which is usual or natural.
3 Absence of any characteristic.
E.
विलक्ष, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-ण्यं)
Difference, contrariety.
E.
विलक्षण, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वी-ल्वं)
Relating or belonging to the Vilva tree.
n. (-ल्वं)
The fruit of the Vilva, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
विल्व the plant, अण् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of the Vilva, of the wood, &c. of that plant.
E.
वैल्व relating to the Bel, and मयट् aff.
